body:
Authored template and expression failures at the remaining execution boundaries currently fall back to generic internal errors. This change records a bounded cause at the actual evaluation call and exposes a fixed field, cause and corrective action. Deterministic faults in pinned definitions refuse Resume, while cancellation, provider acceptance, uncertain effects and parent/child completion retain their existing precedence.

Closes #486. Part of #279.

The selected [D188 plan and amendments](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7061825658) cover 26 boundaries, including workspace/script preparation, heartbeat, inference input/output and repair prompts, and subloop mappings. Per-call provenance distinguishes an authored evaluator failure from a same-class provider/storage/binding fault. Newly typed JSONata sites publish and log no evaluator-supplied message; existing Mutate/Exit, provider diagnostics and historical rows retain their separate contracts. [ADR-0088](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/d1177f105bd008fc084ccbbc086ee70e14d13e2f/docs/decisions/ADR-0088-authored-execution-failures.md) records the decision and alternatives. No schema/data migration, format converter, new dependency or automatic retry is introduced.

**This is an unfinished draft opened for normal hosted verification under [D200](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7063236322).** It is not review, QA or merge approval.

- GPT Astra owns the shared architecture and difficult integration; performant GPT Sol workers implemented bounded workspace, leaf-handler and public-test portions. Actual Claude Fable critiqued the architecture. Its implementation adversarial review is unfinished, and separate actual Opus behavior QA is unfinished. [D201](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7063342215) explicitly corrects D188's earlier implementation-review model name to Fable 5.2 / xhigh; Opus 5.5 / xhigh remains independent behavior QA.
- Both first implementation-review/QA attempts ended at provider quota with exit 1 / `is_error=true` and no verdict. The independent domain observation stage passed 36/36 before the limit. Remaining native filesystem, script-effect, HTTP/SQLite, REST/MCP/browser, recovery and nested-child checks remain unverified. Partial work and all provider errors are retained; planning critique does not substitute for implementation review.
- Local build and repository static checks passed. The combined coverage attempt failed four cases; one bounded candidate/baseline comparison passed those unchanged cases, leaving the original cause unproven. The existing serial coverage command then passed 484 domain and 1,998 engine cases but failed 52 infrastructure cases with 1,115 passing; later packages were not all reached. Four unchanged failed files on the clean baseline showed the same 52 case-name failures. This is qualified baseline evidence, not a full local coverage pass. D195/D196 retain all failures and require ordinary hosted coverage without threshold, exclusion or privilege changes.

Frozen implementation source is `633d9ac72c10fe4b8d76f7ba50221f9ed8557cb9`. The separately integrated delivery head is `d1177f105bd008fc084ccbbc086ee70e14d13e2f`, tree `dd2c051567d317f91d092a658bce553a8b8eb16b`, with main `02a0000998fa119be7553ddc06a60b63fbde1e31`. All 50 production/test/other original source blobs remain exact; the two remaining original files, CHANGELOG and docs/06, preserve both parents' additive/disjoint changes. All 854 inherited evidence files remain exact. The author and independent QA checkouts remain clean at `633d9ac7` with all 52 source hashes and index bytes preserved.

Before merge: complete actual opposite-family review and independent touched-system QA; publish their source-bound raw evidence and all failed attempts under docs/qa; satisfy all ordinary current-head/current-target CI, coverage and canonical native-artifact checks; complete the reserved fresh independent Astra MAX final audit within the three-general-scan cap. Later archive/source/target changes require fresh ordinary CI. No owner store, deployed instance, paid provider access or owner acceptance is changed or claimed.
